landing_bad_stratum_interface.exact_kernel_condition: the unshifted physical landing kernel is proper on the original outer registry iff lambda-almost every positive fibre lies outside B_land

landing_bad_stratum_interface.markov_bound: for B_k={z_land>=2^k*C_p}, integral_(B_k)h dlambda <= J_land,min,total/(2^k*C_p), so the very-bad tail vanishes as k tends to infinity

maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.Borel_measurability: Round57 enumerates maximal positive components by a least-rational owner with Borel endpoint infimum/supremum; component mass and adapted length are Borel, and the monotone countable sum of mass/length is Borel
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.Round57_consequence: J_land,min,total is therefore physically finite, but global finiteness is not the fibrewise strict C_p*h threshold
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.Round57_global_join: Round57 step 3 constructs the common restriction on I(B) with global affine bound Z_3<infinity; time reversal preserves adapted length and Z, and maximal physical coarsening gives J_land,min,total<=Z_3<infinity on B
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.attainment: restrict the inherited regular density once to each maximal component C; this is an exact positive representation and attains sum_C kappa_y(C)/ell(C)
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.coarsening: every legal same-ID same-chart coarsening is already included by the maximal actual-union components; no merge may cross a true gap, singularity or cemetery puncture
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.cross_registry_guard: the theorem does not exclude a future cross-y or cross-chart physical Rokhlin redisintegration built from an actual stable-holonomy quotient; that would be a new Gate-2/physical interface, not a same-ID coarsening
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.cuts: positive cuts only shorten W and cannot decrease the minimum
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.lower_bound_proof: a canonical pair has strictly positive regular density on its connected carrier W, so W cannot cross a positive-length gap or omitted puncture; W lies in one C and ell(W)<=ell(C), hence integrating p_W/ell(W) over all pairs in C gives at least kappa_y(C)/ell(C)
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.multiple_family_iff: allowing a countable exact partition into positive candidate families does not weaken the threshold: if every positive subfamily has J_i/h_i<C_p then sum_i J_i/sum_i h_i is their outer mass-weighted average and is strictly <C_p; conversely J_land,min<C_p*h makes the single maximal-component family proper; zero-mass fibres are empty
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.registry_scope: fix one immutable (y, physical landing carrier chart, physical restriction ID); remove singular, null and cemetery punctures and use the maximal connected positive components C of the actual landing support
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.strict_same_time_iff: an exact positive unshifted landing standard family preserving y and the physical ID is proper iff J_land,min(y)<C_p*h(y)
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.tags: forgetting proof-only tags cannot go below J_land,min; forgetting an immutable physical ID is outside the kernel contract
maximal_component_minimum_Z_theorem.zero_policy: h(y)=0 has the empty component registry, J_land,min(y)=0 and z_land(y)=0 and is never normalized
